expected.reason: Confirmed by the function's own declaration at line 407 -- no `throws`. Every failure category in this function (extraction, manifest read/parse, per-file download, per-folder merge) is caught internally and turned into a `logAppMessage` call; nothing ever propagates as a Swift error the caller could catch. This is exactly the structural fact phase8-scope.md's 'Modpack create/import boundary' section cites as why the wizard's outer create-rollback `catch` can never see a pack-import failure today -- there is nothing for it to catch.
